FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know to get started with DriveHub securely.
FAQ.q1: Does DriveHub work without an internet connection?
FAQ.a1: DriveHub is a cloud platform. However, the app is optimized to work with very low bandwidth, which is ideal for areas with unstable network coverage in Cameroon.
FAQ.q2: How does Mobile Money integration work?
FAQ.a2: We natively support Orange Money and MTN Mobile Money. You can configure your accounts directly in your dashboard to securely and seamlessly receive registration fees.
FAQ.q3: Can students practice traffic regulations online?
FAQ.a3: Yes, we offer a test database compliant with the Cameroonian traffic code, featuring clear explanations and real-time progress tracking for the student.
FAQ.a4: Absolutely. We use secure servers with regular backups. Your information is encrypted according to modern security standards.
